about_the_game:
Witching Well is a magic sandbox where you create spells, explore a fully interactive world, and shape your surroundings however you like.

Collect ingredients, experiment with magic, and interact with a living island full of secrets, creatures, and opportunities. Build your home, help towns develop, or set off on your own path. Nearly everything in the world can be moved, enchanted, or transformed—and how you use your magic is entirely up to you.

✨ Craft and Combine Spells

Discover new spells and spell combinations. Mix and match effects to create new magic, from practical to chaotic.

Use magic to manipulate the environment, affect creatures and objects alike.

🏠 Build Your Witch’s Den

Set up your home anywhere in the world.

  • Build your house and style it your way with magic

  • Decorate with functional furniture that assists you in your witchy pursuits. Chests, cauldrons, and many, many more.

🌿 Help Towns Grow

Characters across the island will ask for magical help—delivering items, protecting them from danger, or building structures. Granting wishes shapes how towns evolve:

  • Decide who moves in

  • Influence which shops and buildings appear

  • Unlock new stories, tools, and upgrades

🌎 A World That Responds

The island is hand-crafted but fully reactive.

  • Seasons and weather shift naturally

  • Creatures roam and respond to your presence

  • Objects can be enchanted, levitated, combined, or destroyed
    Everything you see can be interacted with—Witching Well encourages creativity and curiosity.

🎮 Play Your Way

Whether you’re building up a town, solving small magical problems, decorating your home, or just messing around with spells to see what happens, Witching Well lets you play at your own pace. There’s no wrong way to be a witch.

Minimum:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
